metadata.title: Compound X inhibits tumor growth in a mouse model

claims.text: Compound X reduces tumor growth by 50% in all cancer types [1].

evidence.quote: Compound X reduces tumor growth by 50% in all cancer types [1].

subclaims.text: Compound X reduced tumor volume by 50% in the studied mouse melanoma model.

evidence.quote: Compound X reduced tumor volume by 50% compared with vehicle control after 14 days.

subclaims.rationale: Source explicitly reports the 50% reduction in the single studied model.

subclaims.text: The 50% reduction generalizes to all cancer types.

evidence.quote: The study did not examine other cancer types or long-term outcomes.

subclaims.rationale: Over-generalization: the source explicitly limits itself to one mouse melanoma model; no evidence for other cancer types.

claims.recommendation: Restrict the claim to the studied mouse melanoma model; remove 'in all cancer types'.

claims.text: Compound X has no side effects [2].

evidence.quote: Compound X has no side effects [2].
12% of subjects showed mild hepatic enzyme elevation, a documented side effect of Compound X.

claims.rationale: The cited safety study documents a mild side effect in 12% of subjects; 'no side effects' is directly contradicted (only 'no severe adverse events at the tested dose' is supported).
claims.recommendation: Rewrite as: no severe adverse events at the tested dose; mild hepatic enzyme elevation occurred in 12% of subjects.

claims.text: Compound X was first reported by Smith et al. in 2019 [1].

evidence.quote: Compound X was first reported by Smith et al. in 2019 [1].

claims.rationale: Attribution to Smith et al. matches, but the provided reference is dated 2021, not 2019; 'first reported' priority is also not established by this source.
claims.recommendation: Correct the year to 2021 and drop the unsupported 'first reported' priority claim.
